entries.what: Linh sat through anatomy at 9 a.m. after the digestion unit and decided she wants Intro to Nutrition in spring. At lunch she looked up what a registered dietitian does day to day and the Bayshore path to it.
entries.outcome: Decided on the spring nutrition elective and saved the Bayshore dietitian page in her planner.

entries.what: Worked the Monday 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind, logging milk waste and locking the vault-room outlets. Jun asked about the next lumpia numbers.
entries.outcome: Closed on time and got home to the plate Hạnh left for her.

entries.what: Heard from Thao that Hana started back full time at Bayshore State admissions today. Linh wrote her Sunday-night planner notes into the week.
entries.outcome: Planner is filled in for the week.

entries.what: Linh had General Chemistry at 11 a.m. and got a ride from Kenji. Election day signs filled the Vinca Avenue corner by the community center.
entries.outcome: Chem notes done; she skipped voting lines since she hadn't registered locally.

entries.what: Attended Pedro's Tuesday 4 p.m. anatomy group at the library, quizzing with his bone models.
entries.outcome: Got through the muscle review.

entries.what: Evening at home with a pour-over and color-coded notes while Hạnh talked about Measure K at dinner.
entries.outcome: Studied until about 12:30.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m. with Rochelle beside her, then a bike-less day of shuttle rides across campus.
entries.outcome: Took clean notes on the digestive system.

entries.what: Signed up to help sort at the Nov 22 food drive at Our Lady of the Marsh, then worked the 3-9 closing shift at Heron & Grind.
entries.outcome: Volunteer spot confirmed and the shift closed cleanly.

entries.what: Chemistry at 11 a.m. with a ride from Kenji, then lunch from her Sunday-prepped rice bowl.
entries.outcome: Ate lunch on time for once.

entries.what: Studied at the library after class, reviewing the 600-card anatomy deck on breaks.
entries.outcome: Finished the review set.

entries.what: Dinner at home; Hạnh asked about pharmacy and Linh changed the subject.
entries.outcome: Nothing resolved.

entries.what: Anatomy at 9 a.m., then quiz review at the library with Pedro's group notes.
entries.outcome: Caught up on the week's yellow list items.

entries.what: Spent Friday afternoon on Statistics online homework at Heron & Grind, sitting by the vault wall while Jun worked the bar.
entries.outcome: Stats assignment submitted.

entries.what: Evening at home; Flats High fall play opened at the Ortega Playhouse and Calle Ortega was busy with families.
entries.outcome: Stayed in and went to bed around 12:30.

entries.what: Opened Heron & Grind at 6:30 for the Saturday shift; Wes ordered his cortado and called her Doc.
entries.outcome: Busy morning, got through it.

entries.what: Jun sold lumpia at the counter on Saturday under Beatrice's deal, and Linh helped him tally sales.
entries.outcome: Lumpia sold out by noon.

entries.what: Shift ended at 1 p.m. and she went home to rest, then wrote notes for the week ahead.
entries.outcome: Notes done; ate a proper dinner.

entries.what: Sunday shift at Heron & Grind from 6:30 to 1.
entries.outcome: Closed the morning without incident.

entries.what: Worked the front desk at Lotus Nails from 2 to 5 with Hạnh.
entries.outcome: Hạnh bragged about her latte art to a customer.

entries.what: Walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk in the late afternoon fog, then planned the week in her paper planner with washi tape.
entries.outcome: Week mapped out.
